ideas.title: Following the Money: An Investigation into Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Minnesota welfare fraud scandal and follow the money to determine where the funds were misused and who was involved.
questions: Where did the misused funds go?
Who was involved in the scandal?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased oversight in government programs. I will use data analysis and public records to follow the money and determine the extent of the scandal.
